scope: Generic Flow function calls, inline definitions, mixed image/text batching and Anki decoupling

sourceRelocation.reason: Byte-identical move after this baseline to restore the single application Flow to System Recovery; earlier validation counts remain historical

contracts.inlineFunctions: Complete Flow definitions in functions; lexical resolution; frozen recursively with the parent revision
contracts.parameterSets: Named argument objects; common arguments overridden by row; isolated scopes; ordered named return objects
contracts.batch: Arbitrary arrays or groups-only input; positive batchSize; combined/grouped modes; no domain field interpretation
contracts.durability: Frozen compiled templates and graph scopes persist in the existing Kernel checkpoint; malformed restored rows fail closed
contracts.businessBoundary: The baseline used one external Flow file. A later byte-identical relocation restores it as application product data; the external package owns Tool implementations, and core execution remains generic.
